body:
Every project gets a decision log that Solace keeps. Only the human decides what goes in it. Today only this repo has one (`DECISIONS.md`), and the Strategy brief shows it only if the file exists (`strategy.rs`).

### Behaviour

- Solace creates the log for new and migrated projects. It is protected like `AGENTS.md`.
- An agent proposes an entry: a title, what was decided and why, written at the human's involvement level. It becomes a decision only after the human approves it, like a settings proposal. An agent's *call made* (see **Agent behaviour settings**) is never added on its own.
- Work, investigate, review and Strategy briefs list the recent decision titles and say how to read one, as the Strategy brief does today.
- The human can read the log in the app, for example on the Knowledgebase page, without opening the file.

### To decide in the investigation

Whether this repo's `DECISIONS.md` becomes this format or stays as it is, and the file's name and location.
title: decisions: a decision log in every project
